_about: ASR correction table for the generic profile. Every pair below was written for this project by reading how the local engines mishear general AI and software vocabulary; nothing here is carried over from any private vault or third-party table. Longer keys win, so a specific phrase is replaced before a shorter key can eat part of it.

_sections.deterministic: Applied automatically. Only put a pair here when the wrong form is never a legitimate word in this domain.
_sections.context_sensitive: Never applied automatically. Listed so a human or an LLM can judge each occurrence.
